catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class configures the built-in signal generator of an oscilloscope. cap.device.configure.v1 is a patch of readable resource state, but the upstream Scope stores no AWG settings and has no getter for them (src/pico_mcp/scope.py:190-204), so an AWG setting cannot be a readable state field. cap.device.self_test.v1 and cap.device.calibrate.v1 are diagnostics, not generator configuration. The extension maps the upstream set_signal_generator call and returns the settings the clone reports as applied.
catalogue_requests.summary: Configure the built-in signal generator (frequency, peak amplitude, wave).

catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class turns off the built-in signal generator of an oscilloscope. The native stop sets the generator to DC at 0 V (src/pico_mcp/scope.py:206-213); cap.motion.stop.v1 is for motion axes and cap.device.configure.v1 would need a readable state field the upstream class does not keep. The extension is also this driver's safe-state action.
catalogue_requests.summary: Turn the built-in signal generator off (DC at 0 V).

catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class carries a block capture of an oscilloscope with per-channel Vpp/min/max/mean/rms and an estimated frequency. cap.measure.voltage.v1 binds instrument.dmm, instrument.smu and sensor and returns one DC or RMS voltage, not an instrument capture; cap.measure.spectrum.v1 binds instrument.spectrometer and instrument.spectrophotometer and returns an optical spectrum; cap.sensing.image.v1 binds sensor.camera and returns an image artifact. The extension returns the scalar measurements and the capture metadata only; the waveform array is NOT COVERED.
catalogue_requests.summary: Capture one block on all enabled channels and return the scalar measurements.

notes:
PASS on the fake backend: python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/schimmilab__pico-mcp --backend fake exited 0; every gate passed with no finding and no warning. The evidence state is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. The digest above is the digest the last check printed. The package is model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, model deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wC-026) and reviewed_by stays null: no human reviewed or tested it and no hardware run is claimed. It is R1, so the loader does not gate its hardware backend on a reviewed_by signature; this package claims no such protection.

Covered: the connection state, variant, serial, ADC resolution and max_adc; the enabled, coupling and full-scale range of channels A to D, written through cap.device.configure.v1; the built-in signal generator through x-cap.schimmilab.set_signal_generator.v1; the generator stop through x-cap.schimmilab.stop_signal_generator.v1 (the safe-state action); one block capture through x-cap.schimmilab.capture_block.v1 returning the sample count, sample interval, sample rate, duration, timebase and one scalar measurement object per enabled channel. The e-stop calls the native stop_signal_generator() (DC at 0 V, src/pico_mcp/scope.py:206-213); no independent hardware e-stop is documented in the clone, so estop_physical_ref is not set (R1; the safe-state action is provided anyway).

The channel range 0.01 V to 20.0 V is cited at src/pico_mcp/scope.py:25-29; the coupling set DC/AC at src/pico_mcp/scope.py:180. The signal-generator frequency and amplitude and the capture sample count, timebase and trigger level are Limit.operator_required: the clone passes them to the ps5000a calls without a stated range. site-limits.example.json is an example overlay for a bench, not a device bound; without an overlay those capabilities are refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET. The conformance fixture supplies the generator's valid and alternate inputs.

NOT COVERED: (1) the waveform array. capture_block computes a downsampled waveform_mv list of at most 240 points (src/pico_mcp/scope.py:219-224, 380-392) and README.md:92 describes it, but no catalogue class carries a trace array; this package returns the scalar measurements and the settings, and the driver does not put the array into the extension output. The fake returns no waveform array either. (2) frequency_sweep (src/pico_mcp/scope.py:317-365): a composite sweep that drives the generator and captures repeatedly; it is not exposed as a capability. (3) the analog offset: the upstream ChannelState stores only enabled, coupling, range_volts and range_enum (src/pico_mcp/scope.py:91-96), so there is no read-back to serve as state; each channel write passes analog_offset=0.0, the upstream default (src/pico_mcp/scope.py:174-175). (4) the connect/disconnect lifecycle: native.py connects the hardware factory and teardown disconnects; no capability opens or closes the unit. (5) the ADC resolution is read-only; the hardware factory takes resolution_bits, and the upstream default is 12 bits (src/pico_mcp/scope.py:104). (6) probe_devices and the FastMCP server (src/pico_mcp/server.py) are not used; this is a direct Driver over pico_mcp.scope:Scope, not the MCP front end.

A channel that has never been configured has no entry in Scope.channels, so its enabled/coupling/range fields are omitted from the state rather than invented; the fake starts with channels A and B enabled and C and D disabled, all placeholder test data. The fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording of an instrument; every number and string in it is marked # placeholder and none is used as a Fact, a Limit or a reference. The hardware path (native.py, picosdk, the USB unit) was never imported or run; nothing here ran on an instrument, and no hardware backend was passed to the gate.

The upstream clone stayed read-only at commit 08fd81ee1c1e79b4d82e0997ca840b46adeef811; no upstream code was copied. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; the digest above is the digest the last check printed.
